sections.title: The products
sections.text: This shop offers digital STL files. No physical item is shipped. Images illustrate the models; colour, material and final appearance depend on your print and finish.

sections.title: Prices & payment
sections.text: Catalogue prices are in euros (EUR). The order amount is shown before payment. Payments are processed on the payment provider’s secure page; this site does not collect card numbers.

sections.title: Access to files
sections.text: Downloads are available on your order page after payment verification. Private order access expires after 24 hours; individual download links expire after five minutes. You can request a new private access link by email. Back up your files and keep private links safe.

sections.title: Personal use
sections.text: Buying a model permits personal use. Redistribution and commercial use require separate permission from the studio.

sections.title: Immediate digital delivery
sections.text: I expressly request immediate delivery of the digital files and acknowledge that I lose my right of withdrawal once delivery begins. My rights for defective or non-conforming files remain.

sections.title: Questions & support
sections.text: For a file or order issue, contact the studio using the contact form and include the relevant reference.

sections.title: Your data
sections.text: Your cart is stored locally in your browser. The name, email and message submitted through the form are stored to handle your enquiry. Your name, email, order details, consent and download access records are stored to process orders and support access. Information needed for payment is sent to the payment provider. Use the contact form for enquiries about your data.
